description: This source file defines the ProductOption entity class, which models a product option in an e-commerce system. It includes annotations for ORM mapping, fields for option data, and accessor methods.

classes.name: ProductOption
classes.description: Entity class representing a product option, with attributes like ID, type, code, sorting order, descriptions, and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sorting order of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order of the product option.

methods.name: getProductOptionType
methods.description: Returns the type of the product option.

methods.name: setProductOptionType
methods.description: Sets the type of the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the set of descriptions associated with this product option.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product option.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product option.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this product option.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with this product option.

methods.name: getDescriptionsSettoList
methods.description: Converts the descriptions set to a list, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the product option is read-only.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the product option is read-only.
